resources.string: Covers private app files, caches and WebView data. Logical size is the sum of regular file lengths. Excludes external storage and the APK.
Available on the app data volume: %1$s

Cleanup first stops DSH and terminals safely, then removes allowlisted regenerable caches and verified old files that qualify. Manual cleanup may archive completed older DSH copies with byte-for-byte verification. You can unpack them to their original history folders. The newest unpacked copy keeps its original form. Failed and unknown copies stay in place. Chats, attachments, personal files, settings, original plugins, backups and historical audit files are kept.
